      • getMelodicIntervalSequence

        public java.util.ArrayList<meico.supplementary.KeyValue<java.lang.Double,PitchInterval>> getMelodicIntervalSequence(boolean loopToFirstNote)
        Returns the sequence of melodic intervals. This expects a monophonic voice!
        Parameters:
        loopToFirstNote - if true, the final note loops to the first note
        Returns:
        the series of intervals between successive notes, entry format is (MIDI tick date of the 2nd note, PitchInterval between 1st and 2nd note)
